slug: 2026-02-02 Benin reports 75% of identification services accessed through digital platforms

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Benin has launched a digital civil registration system linked with health facilities for the issuance of a birth certificate at birth, the newborn also receiving a Personal Identification Number on registration; it puts the pilot's launch in October 2025.
facts.system: Digital civil registration system linked with health facilities

facts.fact: Biometric Update states that the digital civil registration initiative is in a pilot phase, launched in October 2025 on its account, and gives no count of facilities.
facts.system: Digital civil registration system linked with health facilities

facts.fact: Biometric Update states that the digital civil registration pilot is supported by UNICEF and the World Bank-funded WURI project; no domestic budget line is stated.
facts.system: Digital civil registration system linked with health facilities

systems.system: Digital civil registration system linked with health facilities
systems.owner: ANIP; supported by UNICEF and the WURI project
systems.tiers: health facilities, pilot phase; registration issues the birth certificate and a Personal Identification Number

systems.country_label: digital government portal, ANIP BJ mobile app, USSD code
systems.tiers: 10.5 million civil status and identification services issued in 2025, at least 75% asked for through digital platforms (37% portal, 30% app, 8% USSD); 3.8 million authentications by telecom operators and 25 million eKYC verifications
self-service mobile application for passport renewal, integrated with the national ID and immigration systems
